basic_info.main_problem: 自从成为Full-time homemaker后，我对not yet来的就业能力感到not安全与怀疑，近几个月加重。我认为原因是缺乏Work经验并担心not yet来找not到Work。我经常与在职父母比较并感到自卑，这些想法每周都会出现，已影响自信并让日常活动难以享受。
basic_info.core_demands: Realized these feelings are affecting my mental health and self-worth, so I seek counseling.
growth_experiences: 成为Full-time homemaker后逐渐出现对not yet来就业的not安全感与怀疑，近几个月明显加重；认为缺乏Work经验会导致not yet来难以被雇用，频繁与在职父母比较并感到自卑；这些感受每周出现并影响了与其他家长的关系以及对烹饪、跑步等活动的享受；有支持性的丈夫与朋友，但尚not yet向他们倾诉；No major physical illness史，既往without相似心理问题与治疗史。

special_situations.event: When interacting with working parents or thinking about their career achievements
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not如其他父母那样成功，就说明I am worthless、not值得被尊重
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 下意识与他人进行比较以检验自我价值；避免向他人倾诉，独自承受自卑与Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我永远not会像他们一样成功

special_situations.event: Imagining oneself attending a job interview
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我答not上问题或被嘲笑，就证明I have no value且not可能被雇用
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 试图Repression和deny相关念头，避免与家人或朋友讨论
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 面试官会嘲笑我，我会什么都答not上来

special_situations.event: 想到not yet来的Work前景与财务独立时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我找not到Work，一旦家里出事我就without法支持家庭，后果not堪设想
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 反复预想最坏情境以自我“准备”，同时持续Self-denial
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 如果发生意外，我也without法支持家庭

special_situations.event: When realizing one lacks formal work experience
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: have not连续的正式Work经历就意味着have not人会雇用我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 用“not经验”的标签定义自己，忽视家庭管理与育儿中形成的可迁移skill
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: have not人会雇用have not经验的我

core_conflict.wish: Longs to gain a sense of self-worth and others' recognition through work, and achieve a degree of financial independence
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败与Being rejected，担心被贬低为“without能/not值得”的人，甚至在家庭遭变故时without法承担责任
defense_goal: 通过Repression与回避相关念头保持脆弱自尊的稳定
保持Silencenot与支持系统沟通以避免暴露脆弱与被评价

object_relations.self_representation: not够好、可能失败的“弱者/失败者”
object_relations.object_representation: Successful others who may judge and laugh at me (such as working parents, interviewers)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当谈及not yet来求职或被邀请具体化面试场景时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Others will be as picky as interviewers and even laugh at me (negative presumption about others' intentions)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以Empathy、验证为主，温和Clarification证据与推断的差异，邀请举例与细化感受，避免对抗式质疑。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当出现关于“without法被雇用”的强烈Anxiety念头时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: If I face these thoughts directly I will completely collapse, so I must suppress them
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using gentle, slow guidance anchored in body sensations to help label and hold emotions, encouraging the use of the phrase 'at this moment I notice...' to describe present experience.
